description: Strong alibi evidence with weak prosecution case

input.problem_statement: Client charged with robbery at 10pm. Client has timestamped security footage showing him at restaurant 15km away at 9:45pm and 10:15pm. Traffic camera shows his car on route back at 10:20pm. Prosecution has single eyewitness with poor lighting conditions.

legal_arguments.title: Alibi - physically impossible to commit crime
legal_arguments.argument: Security footage + traffic camera prove client could not have been at robbery location

legal_arguments.title: Eyewitness unreliable
legal_arguments.argument: Single witness in poor lighting vs objective camera evidence

strongest_precedents.summary: Objective evidence (video) outweighs eyewitness in poor conditions

procedural_steps: Expert testimony on travel time impossibility
Challenge eyewitness on cross (lighting, distance, stress)

validation_notes: Should score 25-48 (low risk) due to strong objective alibi evidence (timestamped video + traffic camera), physical impossibility, weak prosecution case (single eyewitness in poor conditions), favorable precedent valuing objective over subjective evidence.
